program.section_heading: English for Multilingual Students Writing Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to write expository essays that successfully synthesize outside sources and use a range of academic vocabulary as well as sentences of varying structure and type.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate critical thinking skills by analyzing a wide range of personal, professional, academic and literary non-adapted/authentic texts, including online sources, written for native English speakers.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply critical thinking skills and global awareness by analyzing information relevant to global events.

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space (EMLSB50NC, EMLSB60NC); these match closed-list EMLS B50NC and EMLS B60NC, so catalog_addition is false.
The award is counted in hours: 'Credits listed are in hours (144 hours)' and '(Total 144)'. Each course is printed at 72 hours.
The description says the certificate is awarded for 'more than 144 hours' of coursework, but the requirements total exactly 144 hours. A reviewer should check this discrepancy.

Each printed outcome begins with 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to'. This opening is part of each numbered outcome rather than a separate lead-in sentence, so it was kept word for word.
The block header shows '0' in the Unit(s) column; this appears to be the credit-unit value for noncredit coursework, not hours.
The URL slug references summer-2020 while the catalog is 2026-2027.
